note: Seconds per test of the default-feature workspace library tests on GitHub's hosted runners, used only to balance the parts of rust-workspace-lib-parts. Derived from one job log per system of the unsplit run (four test threads; each test timed from its start in libtest's name-order schedule to its result line): rust_workspace_lib_plan.py LOG --system S --source TEXT. Tests under one second are not named; a test the table does not name weighs its system's other, the mean of those.
